content: While the same span of text cannot have multiple named entity labels, it can have different propaganda labels. We get around this problem by picking one of the labels at random. Additionally, so as to speed up training, we only train our model on those sentences that contain some propagandistic fragment. In hindsight, we note that both these decisions were not ideal and discuss what we might have otherwise done in Section SECREF7.
